constraints.ocl:
context Patient
inv: self.isInsured implies self.insurance <> null

context Hospital
inv: (self.departments->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null) and (self.departments->size() = 3)

context Hospital
inv: self.wards->any(x | x.floor >= 5) <> null

context Hospital
inv: (self.wards->collect(x | x.name)->notEmpty()) and (self.address <> '' and self.address.size() > 0)

context Invoice
inv: self.totalAmount >= 6 and self.totalAmount <= 65

context Invoice
inv: self.totalAmount >= 4 and self.totalAmount <= 6

context Department
inv: self.nurses->size() >= 2 and self.nurses->size() <= 3

context Ward
inv: self.floor >= 32 and self.floor <= 89

context Ward
inv: (self.name <> null) and (self.rooms->any(x | x.roomNo <> '') <> null)
